title: Beta D : 0 min duration temp basals
body:
I was just looking at the past basals and was astonished to see several 0 min temp basals.

![Screenshot_20221204_153223_AAPS.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/205581021-aa96728a-f67b-41f5-9ebd-bc63ae19d19d.jpg)

No idea what S means either.

Several days ago, they were there too.

comments.body: id does mean "SUSPENDED". Dash is using it in some cases and from AAPS point of view this doesn't break anything
